summary: BTC ~$77.7k, +0.7% in 24h after closing October ~7% down. Binance hack overhang easing further: FBI pinned it on North Korea's TraderTraitor, Binance covered losses and withdrawals resume in phases from 1 Nov. Moscow Exchange to list BTC/ETH/USDT trading from 1 Dec. Some treasury firms (Next Technology, Iole) authorising BTC sales is a mild drag. Slightly less bearish than last night.
